The '''Chokan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] at grid coordinates Q-13. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chokan]] and was the name of one of the systems in the logs of a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] located at the [[Dathomir Imperial Prison]].
